title: The Real Don Returns 2
desc: Pullu Giri is trying to live a peaceful life and forget his ruffian past. Following an incident, he gets dragged into the affairs of some local gangs.

title: Sabse Bada Khiladi
desc: Inspector Vijay infiltrates a rich businessman's family to investigate the death of his twin brother and exact revenge on the murderer.

title: Army
desc: Arjun, a military officer, is killed by Naagraj, a gangster, during an undercover mission. Devastated by this tragedy, Arjun's pregnant wife Geeta decides to get revenge against Naagraj.

title: Marakastra
desc: Whilst Shankar instils patriotism in pupils through musical lessons, a mysterious occultist lends his supernatural support to bolster MLA Muddurama's quest for political power.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: ACP Prithviraj, an honest man, arrests Chief Minister Baburao's son for raping a woman. Consequently, Baburao leaves no stone unturned to get revenge against Prithviraj.
